user.title: Connect a pellet stove
user.description: Enter the stove hostname or address.

reconfigure.title: Update the stove address
reconfigure.description: Enter the hostname or address of the same stove.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the stove.
error.unknown: The stove returned an unexpected response.
error.invalid_host: Enter a hostname or address without a URL scheme or path.
error.unique_id_mismatch: The new address could not be verified as the same stove.

init.title: Polling and power monitoring

data_description.power_sensor: Optional. Select a smart plug power sensor that reports in watts. Clear the selection to turn off mismatch detection.
data_description.power_threshold: The power draw that suggests the stove is active. Defaults to 30 W.

init.description: Common status and preferences are polled every 10–300 seconds. Diagnostics are fetched at most every 300 seconds.

error.invalid_power_threshold: Enter a finite power threshold in watts.

board_state_mismatch.title: {stove}: Wi-Fi board may be reporting a stale state
board_state_mismatch.description: The stove state and the external power reading have disagreed for several minutes. Check the stove's display and make sure the selected power sensor measures the stove in watts. This repair clears automatically when the readings agree again.

whole_temperature_required.message: Target temperature must be a whole number of degrees Celsius.

final_cleaning.message: The stove is finishing its cleaning cycle. Turn it on again after it switches off.

unknown_power_state.message: The stove reported an unknown power state ({state}). The command was not sent.

power_change_pending.message: The stove has not confirmed the previous power command yet. Try again once it reports the new state.

standby.message: The stove is in standby. Use the stove controls to switch it on or off.

alarm.message: The stove reports an alarm. Clear it on the stove before using power commands.

power_unacknowledged.message: The stove did not answer the power command. It may still act on it; its power state is being checked.

power_rejected.message: The stove rejected the power command. Check the stove before trying again.
